map.净利 / 总资产 使用指南: Net Profit / Total Assets User Guide
map.输入净利润与平均总资产，计算总资产收益率 ROA，衡量单位资产创利能力，适用于企: Enter the net profit and the average total assets to compute the return on assets (ROA), which measures profit generated per unit of assets and suits profitability efficiency assessment and benchmarking across periods and industries.
map.ROA = 净利润 / 平均总资产。: ROA = net profit / average total assets.
map.衡量企业运用全部资产创利的能力，评价管理层资源配置效率。: Measures the company's ability to generate profit with all its assets and evaluates how efficiently management allocates resources.
map.对比同业 ROA，判断资产扩张是否带来相应回报。: Compare ROA with peers to judge whether asset expansion brought a matching return.
map.投资者结合 ROA 与杠杆，理解 ROE 的来源。: Investors combine ROA with leverage to understand where ROE comes from.
map.计算总资产收益率: Compute the return on total assets
map.：某公司净利润 400 万元、平均总资产 4000 万元，ROA=400/400: A company with net profit 4,000,000 and average total assets of 40,000,000 has ROA=400/4000=10%, meaning each 1 of assets creates 0.1 of net profit a year.
map.由三因子求净资产收益率: Return on Equity from Three Factors
map.由流动资产与流动负债求营运资金: Working capital from the current assets and the current liabilities
map.ROA 和 ROE 的区别？: What is the difference between ROA and ROE?
map.ROA 看全部资产（含负债形成）的回报，ROE 只看股东投入的回报；ROE 因杠: ROA measures the return on all assets (including those funded by debt) while ROE looks only at the return on shareholders' capital. ROE is amplified by leverage, so ROA reflects the earning power of the assets themselves more directly.
map.ROA 偏低但 ROE 高说明什么？: What does a low ROA with a high ROE mean?
map.说明企业大量运用负债放大了股东回报，但同时也累积了财务风险，需警惕杠杆不可持续。: It shows that heavy use of debt has amplified the shareholder return but has also accumulated financial risk, so watch that the leverage is sustainable.
